# Bounce samples from flufl.bounce

The `*.txt` files in this directory are the test data from [flufl.bounce](https://gitlab.com/warsaw/flufl.bounce) 5.0.1 (`tests/data/` in its source distribution), copied unmodified.

flufl.bounce is Copyright (C) 2004-2026 Barry Warsaw and is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0; the license text is in [`LICENSE`](LICENSE). These files are covered by that license, not by LambdaMLM's MIT license.

LambdaMLM's tests use them as a broad set of real-world bounce messages from many mail systems, to record how the bounce classifier behaves before and after the Python 3 port.
